_comment: I33 observe-coverage allowlist. Governance mirrors .complexity-allowlist.json (I30): every entry needs a valid category and a rationale >= 40 chars; a stale entry (fn no longer in scope) hard-fails even in warn-mode. Categories: hot-loop, generated, trivial, property, dunder, framework-instrumented, test, pre-existing. P1 (retrieval read path, ADR-0034) populated the retrieval-area exemptions below. The low-value presentation/CLI/generated/bootstrap tail is exempted en-masse via _exempt_globs (path-glob, one entry per directory or file). ADR-0040 option B (I33 glob blind-spot): _exempt_globs now hold ONLY CATEGORICALLY-non-observable dirs/files (a future fn there is also boilerplate: CLI glue, seed/export/migration codegen, package/logging/observe/timing framework, pure-render presentation files with no I/O). MIXED-logic files (viz_server.py, graph_api.py that COMPUTE the graph — real observable work) were removed from the glob and their real fns tier-instrumented @observe or given a governed per-fn exemption, so a NEW/modified fn there is no longer auto-invisible. Do NOT bulk-add all ~1,600 in-scope functions here.

server_helpers:_cosine_similarity.rationale: Per-item hot-loop scorer called once per candidate during ranking; a per-call span is per-item cardinality bloat that floods Tempo (ADR-0074 span storm). Carries @observe(span=False) so the metric/attributes stay on the enclosing recall span but no per-call span is opened.

client:_ClientMixin._extract_id.rationale: Per-row RecordID->int coercion called once per record during every recall row-conversion (tens of thousands of calls per op); a per-call span is per-item cardinality bloat that saturated the OTLP queue and DROPPED boundary spans (ADR-0074 span storm). Carries @observe(span=False): the per-call work folds into the enclosing recall span with no independent span opened (hot tier emits no per-call metric/log by design, so nothing observable is lost).

client:_ClientMixin._row_to_dict.rationale: Per-row SurrealDB-record->dict normaliser called once per record during every recall row-conversion (tens of thousands of calls per op, and it calls _extract_id per row); a per-call span is per-item cardinality bloat that saturated the OTLP queue and DROPPED boundary spans (ADR-0074 span storm). Carries @observe(span=False): the per-call work folds into the enclosing recall span with no independent span opened (hot tier emits no per-call metric/log by design, so nothing observable is lost).

cache:Cache._is_expired.rationale: Pure two-line TTL predicate (clock() - write_ts > ttl); no I/O, no ops decision. Called under the lock from the already-@observe'd Cache.get; a span/metric per get would double-instrument the hot path with zero dashboard value.

cache:Cache._record_hit.rationale: One-line internal counter bump (self.hits += 1) plus an optional record_cache_hit call (itself framework-instrumented). Called from the @observe'd Cache.get; wrapping it adds recursive metric noise on every get.

cache:Cache._record_miss.rationale: One-line internal counter bump (self.misses += 1) plus an optional record_cache_miss call (itself framework-instrumented). Called from the @observe'd Cache.get; wrapping it adds recursive metric noise on every miss.

cache:Cache._record_evict.rationale: One-line delegation to record_cache_evict (itself framework-instrumented) on the cold-tier eviction path. Called from the @observe'd Cache.put; a span/metric here double-instruments the same eviction event.

wiki:_current_wiki_epoch.rationale: Two-line guarded read of the global structural wiki epoch (_current_epoch(None) from the shadow bus) folded into the wiki_read/wiki_query cache keys. No I/O of its own, no ops decision; the enclosing @_tool wiki_read/wiki_query already carry a span source.

dispatch_helper:_current_wiki_epoch.rationale: Two-line guarded read of the global structural wiki epoch (_current_epoch(None) from the shadow bus) folded into the agent-prompt prelude cache key. No I/O of its own; the enclosing @_tool agent_dispatch_prelude already carries a span source.

metrics:record_cache_hit.rationale: Observability framework primitive: increments the generic yadgar_cache_hit_total{cache} counter. Circular import with observe.py; wrapping a per-hit metric writer in @observe adds recursive span/metric noise at high per-call cardinality.

metrics:record_cache_miss.rationale: Observability framework primitive: increments the generic yadgar_cache_miss_total{cache} counter. Circular import with observe.py; wrapping a per-miss metric writer in @observe adds recursive span/metric noise at high per-call cardinality.

metrics:record_cache_evict.rationale: Observability framework primitive: increments the generic yadgar_cache_evictions_total{cache} counter. Circular import with observe.py; wrapping an eviction-counter writer in @observe adds recursive metric noise.

metrics:set_cache_size.rationale: Observability framework primitive: sets the generic yadgar_cache_size_entries{cache} gauge at scrape/op time. Circular import with observe.py; wrapping a gauge setter in @observe adds recursive metric noise.

embed_service_metrics:CacheStatsCollecto.rationale: Prometheus Collector protocol method (a generator that yields MetricFamily objects at scrape time). It IS the observability surface for the backend CE/embed cache dual-emit; @observe cannot wrap a generator without breaking yield semantics, and instrumenting the scrape emitter is recursive.

embed_service_metrics:_SharedObserveBrid.rationale: Prometheus Collector protocol generator (P-SB #6/#50) that yields the shared registry's yadgar_observe_* families onto backend /metrics at scrape time. Same class as CacheStatsCollector.collect: @observe cannot wrap a generator without breaking yield semantics, and instrumenting the scrape emitter that exposes the observe families is recursive self-instrumentation.

embed_service_metrics:_default_backend_c.rationale: Scrape-time data source for CacheStatsCollector: lazy-imports embed_service and returns the CE/embed LRUCache instances. Framework primitive read at /metrics scrape only; instrumenting the metrics-collector's own accessor is recursive noise.

embed_service_metrics:_swap_state_flags.rationale: Scrape-time data source for the yadgar_store_swap_state gauge (P0 #37 5c): reads on-disk marker/dir flags on every /metrics scrape via Gauge.set_function. Instrumenting the metrics-collector's own flag reader is recursive noise, same class as _default_backend_cache_instances.

embed_service_metrics:_bind_swap_state_c.rationale: Import-time registration glue that binds one Gauge.set_function per swap-state label (P0 #37 5c). Runs once at module import inside the metrics module itself; wrapping registry wiring in @observe is recursive metric noise (framework primitive).

yadgar/core/cli/**.rationale: operator-invoked CLI command glue: argparse wiring, table/summary printing, and thin dispatch to already-instrumented service tools. No unattended runtime ops path; a span/metric/log per CLI call adds noise, not insight (obs-standard section-5 'CLI glue' exempt-heavy).

yadgar/core/seed/**.rationale: one-shot project-bootstrap material generation/scan/analysis run interactively via seed_project; not a recurring runtime ops path, so per-function tri-signal instrumentation yields no dashboard value and only diff churn.

yadgar/core/scripts/**.rationale: standalone maintenance/entry scripts (nightly_cycle, hook_runner, wiki_snapshot, yadgar_setup): short-lived batch procs whose spans would not flush and whose outer flow is already logged; instrumenting them is cosmetic per obs-standard hooks/short-proc caveat.

yadgar/core/hooks/**.rationale: standalone Claude Code hook scripts (pretooluse-router, stop/session-end/subagent capture): short-lived per-tool-call procs invoked by Claude Code, installed as dependency-optional global scripts whose observability import is best-effort (try/except ImportError); their spans cannot flush before the proc exits, so per-function tri-signal instrumentation is cosmetic per the obs-standard hooks/short-proc caveat (same class as hook_runner under core/scripts).

yadgar/core/export/**.rationale: on-demand DuckDB export tooling (row coercion, schema build, table fetch/write): pure data-marshalling invoked from an operator export command, not a hot or unattended path; exempt per obs-standard 'seed/migration/codegen' exempt-heavy tail.

yadgar/__main__.py.rationale: package entrypoint argparse/dispatch shim: parses argv and hands off to the CLI, which itself dispatches to instrumented tools; a span here duplicates the CLI boundary with no added signal, entrypoint-glue exemption.

yadgar/_shared/observability/observe.py.rationale: the @observe decorator implementation itself: decorating the instrumentation framework with @observe is circular (a span emitter cannot span-source its own emit path); this IS the tri-signal machinery, exempt by construction.

yadgar/_shared/storage/migrations.py.rationale: schema migration boilerplate run once per version bump at startup; generated-style DDL steps with no recurring ops signal to surface on a dashboard, matching the 'generated/migration boilerplate' exemption category.

yadgar/_shared/observability/log_config..rationale: the ENTIRE logging subsystem is the sink @observe's own span+metric+log writes flow into: an @observe here opens a span per log record → LogSpanProcessor emits a 'span_end' log line → that record re-enters the observed log path (filter/format/emit) → more spans → per-log amplification flood that crash-looped core+backend under real OTLP (v5.105 → v5.106). Log-emission functions are un-instrumentable by construction; the thread-local re-entry guard stops infinite recursion but NOT the per-log fan-out. Path-glob so no future @observe on this file can re-open the flood.

yadgar/core/viz/viz_daemon_health.py.rationale: viz daemon health-panel rendering helpers: format health data into presentation structures for the local dashboard; no service logic worth a span, presentation-layer exemption per obs-standard.

yadgar/core/viz/viz_meta.py.rationale: viz metadata presentation helper: shapes metadata for the local viz dashboard render path; pure presentation glue with no ops signal, exempt per obs-standard presentation tail.

yadgar/backend/graph/graph_layout.py.rationale: graph layout geometry computation for the viz dashboard: pure coordinate math for presentation; no external I/O or ops decision to surface, presentation-layer exemption per obs-standard.

blocks_render:render_blocks_section.rationale: pure memory-block markdown renderer: formats block dicts into display lines for hook injection / viz-CLI surface; no I/O, no DB, no ops decision — presentation formatting only. A span/metric per render is noise. (Sole fn in blocks_render.py; glob removed under ADR-0040 option B so a NEW fn there becomes MISSING and visible, but this formatter is categorically non-observable.)

system_metrics:_gc_callback.rationale: gc.callbacks handler that runs DURING garbage collection: (1) it IS a metric-emitter — its body calls yadgar_python_gc_duration_ms.observe(), so @observe (which emits signals) is circular; (2) it fires mid-GC and at interpreter teardown where module globals (time, _gc_start_times) are set to None, so opening a span here is the atexit/shutdown hazard the decorator-contract forbids (span-open on a torn-down path). Not a request/stage op.

graph_api:_limit_clause.rationale: pure branch returning a (sql_suffix, params) tuple for a node cap; no I/O, no ops decision. A span/metric on this two-line pure helper is noise — the enclosing get_full_graph @trace_span already covers the query stage it feeds.

graph_api:GraphAPI._extract_id.rationale: staticmethod that parses one SurrealDB RecordID -> int; called once PER node and PER edge endpoint inside get_full_graph (2000+ entities + memories + wiki + every edge source/target). A span/metric per call is the per-item cardinality bomb — 2000+ spans per graph build. The enclosing get_full_graph @trace_span carries the boundary.

system_metrics:_observe_dbsize_ms.rationale: metric-emitting primitive: sole body observes yadgar_viz_dbsize_sample_duration_ms.observe(elapsed_ms); wrapping a single histogram .observe() in @observe (which emits signals) is recursive span noise for one metric touch with no diagnostic value. Called once per sample_system_metrics cycle.

system_metrics:run_metrics_sampler.rationale: infinite `while True` background sampler thread entry: a boundary/stage @observe would open ONE span for the entire never-returning thread lifetime rather than per-cycle. Per-cycle instrumentation lives on sample_system_metrics (@observe stage), which this loop calls each iteration — same pattern as embed_service._run_cache_snapshot_task.

viz_server:_mime_type.rationale: pure dict .get() mapping a file suffix to a MIME string; no I/O, no branching, no ops decision. The checker's 'get' I/O-sink hint blocks auto-trivial, but this genuinely IS trivial — a span/metric per static-file serve is presentation noise with no dashboard value.

viz_server:_proxy_enabled.rationale: pure env-var read returning whether YADGAR_VIZ_PROXY != '0'; no I/O sink, no ops decision. The checker's 'get' I/O-sink hint blocks auto-trivial, but a span/metric per proxy-flag check is pure noise — the enclosing do_* boundary span already covers the request.

viz_server:_Handler.log_message.rationale: overridden BaseHTTPRequestHandler.log_message whose entire body is `pass` — silences the stdlib per-request access log. Nothing to observe; a span on a deliberate no-op is meaningless.

viz_server:run_viz_server.rationale: viz server bootstrap ending in _ThreadingHTTPServer(...).serve_forever(): a boundary/stage @observe would open ONE span for the entire never-returning server lifetime. Per-request instrumentation lives on the do_GET/do_POST/do_DELETE/do_PUT @observe boundary handlers, which are the real request entry points.

fusion:_FusionMixin._normalize_signal.rationale: Per-signal score normalizer invoked inside the fusion inner loop (once per signal per recall); a span/metric/log per call is per-candidate cardinality + latency bloat on the hot recall path. Parent _wrrf_fuse carries the stage span.

scoring:_normalize_fts_hits.rationale: Normalizes each FTS hit row in the scoring inner loop (per BM25 search per recall); instrumenting per-call would multiply signals per candidate with no dashboard value. Parent _collect_fts_scores carries retrieval.fts span.

cognitive_load:_CognitiveLoadMixin.manag.rationale: Nested closure scoring one chunk per iteration inside manage_context's context-assembly loop; the instrumented parent manage_context carries the span, a per-chunk signal is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

_app:_patch_uvicorn_shutdown_timeout._ss.rationale: Monkeypatch shim replacing uvicorn's SSE shutdown coroutine to enforce the grace timeout; a framework lifecycle patch that must preserve the exact uvicorn call signature, wrapping it with @observe would alter shutdown timing semantics.

_app:_patch_uvicorn_shutdown_timeout._st.rationale: Monkeypatch shim replacing uvicorn's streamable-HTTP shutdown coroutine to enforce the grace timeout; a framework lifecycle patch that must preserve the exact uvicorn call signature, instrumenting it would perturb shutdown timing.

_app:_tool._estimate_tokens.rationale: Nested per-call token estimator inside the _tool decorator wrapper; runs once per tool invocation as pure arithmetic on the arg string, a per-call span/metric duplicates the tool-boundary RED signal the wrapper already emits.

_app:_tool.decorator.rationale: The inner decorator returned by the _tool decorator factory; it attaches wrapping at import/registration time (not a runtime work unit), so a per-call span is meaningless and the instrumented factory _tool already carries the span.

_app:_build_tool_wrappers._emit_metrics.rationale: Nested helper that writes the shared per-tool RED metric families for the wrapper; it IS the metric-emission path, so decorating it with @observe (which emits metrics) would be circular and double-count the tool boundary signal.

_app:_push_trace_complete_event.rationale: Best-effort helper called from the tool-boundary finally (both wrappers, same site as _emit_metrics) to push the trace_complete SSE event for the viz Traces tab; it runs under the tool's own RED span+metric and MUST NOT open a second per-call span (per-tool-call cardinality on the hot boundary) nor raise (fire-and-forget), so it is instrumentation-adjacent like its _emit_metrics sibling. Module-level only to keep _build_tool_wrappers under the I13 cyclomatic cap.

_app:_build_tool_wrappers._maintenance.rationale: Nested per-invocation maintenance hook (pool bookkeeping) inside the tool wrapper; runs under the wrapper's own RED span+metric, a separate per-call signal is redundant with the tool-boundary instrumentation already present.

_app:_build_tool_wrappers._instrumented.rationale: The sync tool-call wrapper body that itself emits the shared per-tool RED span+metric+log for every tool invocation; this closure IS the instrumentation, decorating it with @observe would open a second redundant span per tool call.

_app:_build_tool_wrappers._instrumented_.rationale: The async tool-call wrapper body that itself emits the shared per-tool RED span+metric+log for every tool invocation; this closure IS the instrumentation, decorating it with @observe would double-span each async tool call.

offload:_ctx_wrap._runner.rationale: Nested closure that runs the offloaded callable on the worker thread inside a copied contextvars context; the tool body it runs carries its own trace_span and the instrumented run_offloaded boundary wraps the offload, so a per-run signal here is redundant.

http:_recall_with_timeout._recall_in_ctx.rationale: Nested closure that runs the hook recall callable on the bounded pool thread inside an attached OTel context (ADR-0077 D); _recall_with_timeout is the observed boundary and _forward_hook_recall carries its own boundary signal, so a per-run signal here is redundant.

http:api_heat_histogram._compute.rationale: Nested compute closure run under the api_heat_histogram handler; the handler is the request boundary that carries the span, a separate per-call signal on the inner bucket-computation adds cardinality with no additional ops insight.

http:api_consolidation_log._fetch.rationale: Nested fetch closure run under the api_consolidation_log handler; the enclosing handler carries the request boundary span, an inner per-call signal duplicates it with no dashboard value.

logs:logs_stream_handler.event_generator.rationale: Async generator SSE event loop nested inside logs_stream_handler; @observe sync-wraps and would fire the signal at generator creation not exhaustion, and it streams per-event forever so any per-yield signal is unbounded cardinality — the boundary handler carries the span.

orchestrator:_rollback_daemon._rlog.rationale: Nested logging closure inside _rollback_daemon that appends one rollback-state entry per step; the enclosing _rollback_daemon flow carries the signal, a per-log-line span/metric is per-item noise with no ops value.

__init__:_capture_table_counts._post.rationale: Nested HTTP POST closure invoked per table inside _capture_table_counts; the instrumented parent _capture_table_counts carries the stage span, a per-table per-call signal is per-item cardinality bloat during the one-shot vacuum flow.

__init__:_side_build_swap_and_start._abo.rationale: Nested abort/restart closure inside _side_build_swap_and_start invoked only on the vacuum-swap error path; the enclosing instrumented _side_build_swap_and_start carries the span, a separate signal on this rarely-taken inner handler adds no dashboard value.

_reranking_heuristic:_score_memory.rationale: Scores one memory per iteration of the heuristic_rerank per-candidate loop (N calls per rerank); a span/metric per call = per-candidate bloat. Parent heuristic_rerank carries retrieval.heuristic.rerank stage span.

_reranking_mmr:_cosine_sim.rationale: Cosine similarity called per candidate-vs-selected pair inside the MMR selection loop (O(k*N) calls per rerank); per-call instrumentation is pure per-item cardinality bloat with zero dashboard value.

_reranking_mmr:_max_sim_to_selected.rationale: Computes max similarity to the selected set per candidate inside the MMR inner loop (per-candidate per-iteration); a span/metric per call multiplies signals per candidate on the hot path with no ops value.

_reranking_mmr:_best_mmr_candidate.rationale: Selects the best MMR candidate once per output slot inside the top_k selection loop (per-iteration inner helper); instrumenting per-call bloats cardinality. Parent mmr_rerank carries retrieval.mmr.rerank stage span.

core:Retriever._spreading_bfs_step.rationale: One BFS expansion step invoked once per graph depth inside the spreading_activation while-loop (per-frontier-level); a span/metric per call bloats per-depth cardinality. Parent spreading_activation carries the stage span.

core:Retriever._spreading_apply_activati.rationale: Applies activation for one entity per call inside the legacy per-node BFS loop (per-entity inner helper); per-call instrumentation is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value on the hot recall path.

core:Retriever._spreading_bfs_step_perno.rationale: Legacy per-entity BFS step retained ONLY as the parity baseline for test_spreading_batch_parity.py; not used in production recall. Instrumenting a non-production parity baseline adds noise, not observability signal.

graph_helpers:_GraphHelpersMixin._build_.rationale: Legacy per-node networkx graph builder retained only as the parity baseline for the batched _build_networkx_graph; not on the production recall read path. A span here would trace dead code, not real ops.

compare:recall_compare.rationale: A/B comparison bench harness that runs recall under multiple profiles side-by-side; invoked only by benchmark scripts, never on the production recall read path. Out of P1 read-path scope; instrumentation adds no ops value.

pipeline:_observe_stage_metric.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive that writes the yadgar_recall_stage_duration_seconds histogram feeding existing v5.31 dashboards; wrapping a metric-emitter in @observe would emit a span for a metric write (recursive noise, no value).

pipeline:_observe_candidates.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive that sets the per-stage candidate-count gauges feeding existing v5.31 pipeline dashboards; instrumenting a metric-writer with @observe is recursive span noise with no diagnostic value.

pipeline:_observe_profile_invocation.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive that increments the recall profile-invocation counter feeding existing dashboards; a span around a single counter .inc() is pure noise, not observability signal.

reranking:_observe_recall_stage.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive that observes per-rerank-stage durations into the recall stage histogram (v5.100) feeding live dashboards; wrapping this metric-writer in @observe would double-emit for one metric write.

scoring:_observe_stage.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive that observes a recall-stage duration into yadgar_recall_stage_ms (v5.100) feeding existing dashboards; a span around a single metric .observe() is recursive noise with no ops value.

scoring:_set_stage_attrs.rationale: OTEL span-attribute setter that annotates the CURRENT recall stage span with count ints (v5.100); it mutates the active span rather than opening one, so wrapping it in @observe would emit a redundant child span.

entities:_extract_query_entities._add.rationale: Tiny nested closure that appends a unique name to a local list inside _extract_query_entities; not independently reachable and covered by the parent's hot span. Instrumenting a per-token closure is per-item cardinality bloat.

query_analysis:_extract_comparison_optio.rationale: Nested closure that walks tokens leftward to build a comparison operand string inside _extract_comparison_options; not independently reachable and umbrella-covered by the parent's hot span. Per-call instrumentation is noise.

Nested closure that walks tokens rightward to build a comparison operand string inside _extract_comparison_options; not independently reachable and umbrella-covered by the parent's hot span. Per-call instrumentation is noise.

query_analysis:_build_open_domain_subque.rationale: Tiny nested closure that appends a deduplicated candidate subquery inside _build_open_domain_subqueries; not independently reachable and covered by the parent's hot span. Instrumenting a per-candidate closure adds no value.

temporal:parse_temporal_expression._add_.rationale: Tiny nested closure that appends a parsed temporal-expression hint inside parse_temporal_expression; not independently reachable and umbrella-covered by the parent's hot span. Per-call instrumentation is pure noise.

engram:EngramAllocator.get_excitability.rationale: Reads one slot's decayed excitability; called per-slot inside apply_lateral_inhibition's neighbor loop and per boost_excitability (per-allocation, per-neighbor). A span/metric per call is per-slot cardinality bloat. Parent engram.allocate carries the boundary span.

engram:EngramAllocator._compute_decayed_.rationale: Pure exponential-decay math applied per-slot inside the exc_by_slot dict-comprehension in _allocate_inner and get_slot_statistics (once per slot in the table); per-call instrumentation is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

knowledge_graph:_error_fix_entities.rationale: Builds entity triples for one error-fix regex match; called per-match inside the _ERROR_FIX_RE.finditer loop in _extract_entities_typed_inner (per-match, per-content). A span per match is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent extract_entities_typed carries the boundary span.

knowledge_graph:KnowledgeGraph._ensure_e.rationale: Fetch-or-insert one entity by name; called per source and per target inside add_relationship (twice per relationship-triple, N triples per write/consolidation). Per-call instrumentation is per-entity cardinality bloat. Parent add_relationship carries the stage span.

knowledge_graph:KnowledgeGraph._get_type.rationale: Resolves a source/target/rel_type triple to a relationship row; called per candidate pair inside the detect_causality co-occurrence scan loop (per-pair). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent detect_causality carries the boundary span.

knowledge_graph:KnowledgeGraph._rows_to_.rationale: Projects relationship rows into neighbor dicts for one entity; called per BFS node inside get_neighbors and per-frontier in traversal (per-node). A span per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent get_neighbors/get_subgraph carries the stage span.

knowledge_graph:KnowledgeGraph._get_adja.rationale: Batched adjacency lookup for one BFS frontier; called once per depth level inside the get_subgraph traversal while-loop (per-frontier-level). Per-call instrumentation is per-level cardinality bloat. Parent get_subgraph carries the stage span.

knowledge_graph:KnowledgeGraph._check_te.rationale: Scans recent episodes to order two entities; called per candidate entity pair inside the detect_causality nested loop (per-pair). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent detect_causality carries the boundary span.

_signals:_SignalsMixin._parse_created_at.rationale: Parses one memory's created_at into a datetime; called per directory-memory inside the _most_recent_mention_dt scan loop (per-item, up to 50 memories per surprisal). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value. Key renamed C6 (stem predictive_coding→_signals per I33).

_bypass:_bypass_reason.rationale: Pure string-returning helper (≤4 lines of regex checks); always called from should_store() or would_reject_at(), both of which carry boundary @observe spans. Adding a span here would nest inside a boundary span for a trivial gate-check, producing cardinality noise with no diagnostic value.

_signals:_SignalsMixin._get_cached_entit.rationale: Pure abstract stub (pragma: no cover) — raises NotImplementedError and is always shadowed at runtime by WriteGate._get_cached_entities (the mixin host). Never executed; decorating an abstract stub produces a phantom span that would never fire in practice.

__init__:_drainer_span.rationale: OTEL span factory: returns an un-entered start_as_current_span('drainer.cycle') context manager entered by run(). It OPENS the span rather than being wrapped by one; decorating would emit a redundant second span around the factory call.

__init__:_drainer_heartbeat.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body (past the import guard) is loop_heartbeat('queue_drainer'); wrapping a heartbeat emitter in @observe is recursive span noise for a single metric touch, no diagnostic value.

__init__:_drainer_record_exc.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body is loop_record_exception('queue_drainer', exc); wrapping a loop-error counter emitter in @observe emits a span for one counter .inc(), recursive noise with no ops value.

__init__:QueueDrainer.run.rationale: Infinite drainer thread loop that opens the manual 'drainer.cycle' span per iteration via _drainer_span(); a boundary/stage decorator would span the entire thread lifetime AND double the per-cycle span. The manual cycle span is the correct instrumentation.

__init__:QueueDrainer._observe_drainer_l.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body is yadgar_drainer_lag_ms.observe(...); wrapping a lag-metric writer in @observe emits a span for one histogram .observe(), recursive noise with no diagnostic value.

__init__:QueueDrainer._observe_secret_bl.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: increments yadgar_writegate_outcome for SecretLeakBlocked DLQ entries; wrapping a single counter .inc() in @observe is recursive span noise with no observability signal.

__init__:QueueDrainer._update_dlq_gauges.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sets the P11 queue_depth/dlq_size/rejection_count gauges (I23) once per drain cycle; wrapping a gauge-setter in @observe emits a span for gauge .set() calls, recursive noise with no ops value.

__init__:QueueDrainer._record_failure.rationale: Increments one queue file's retry counter and computes its next backoff; called per failing queue file inside the per-file drain loop (per-item on error). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

__init__:QueueDrainer._build_rejection_r.rationale: Maps one rejection reason to a (failure_reason, metadata) tuple; called per rejected queue file inside _reject_permanent_to_dlq (per-item on policy rejection). A span per call is per-item cardinality bloat; parent process span already covers it.

__init__:_classify_error.rationale: Classifies one error string as permanent/transient via regex; called per failing queue file inside _apply_pending (per-item on error). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

apply:_apply_span.rationale: OTEL span factory: returns an un-entered start_as_current_span('drainer.apply') context manager entered by _apply(). It OPENS the span rather than being wrapped; decorating would emit a redundant second span around the factory call.

apply:_set_apply_op.rationale: OTEL span-attribute setter: sets the 'op' attribute on the active drainer.apply span via get_current_span().set_attribute; it mutates the active span rather than opening one, so wrapping it in @observe would emit a redundant child span.

apply:_ApplyMixin._apply.rationale: Opens the manual 'drainer.apply' span per replayed record via _apply_span() and sets the op attribute; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would produce TWO spans and break test_drainer_apply_span_emits (op-attr assertion).

enforcement:_inc_relaxed.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body is yadgar_writes_with_enforcement_relaxed.labels(...).inc(); wrapping a single counter .inc() in @observe is recursive span noise for one metric touch, no diagnostic value.

dlq:_json_default.rationale: JSON serializer default called per non-serializable object by json.dumps while writing DLQ sidecars (per-object, inner to the serialize loop). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with zero dashboard value.

queue:_json_default.rationale: JSON serializer default called per non-serializable object by json.dumps while writing queue records in enqueue (per-object, inner to the serialize loop). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with zero dashboard value.

queue:FileQueue._cleanup_date_dir.rationale: Deletes stale files in one dated archive sub-directory; called per date-dir inside the cleanup_archive iterdir loop (per-directory). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent cleanup_archive carries the stage span.

queue:FileQueue._find_terminal.rationale: Non-recursive directory glob for a terminal job file; called per poll iteration inside the already-@observe'd wait_for_job (queue.wait_for_job) spin loop. A span/metric per poll is per-iteration cardinality bloat with no dashboard value; the parent stage span covers the wait.

queue:FileQueue._archive_has.rationale: Scans archive/memories/<date>/ for a success-terminal job file; called per poll iteration inside the already-@observe'd wait_for_job (queue.wait_for_job) spin loop. A span/metric per poll is per-iteration cardinality bloat with no dashboard value; the parent stage span covers the wait.

queue:FileQueue._read_dlq_rejection.rationale: Reads a DLQ .error.json sidecar to surface a synchronous duplicate_detected rejection; called per poll iteration on the DLQ-terminal branch of the already-@observe'd wait_for_job (queue.wait_for_job) loop. A span/metric per poll is per-iteration cardinality bloat; the parent stage span covers the wait.

embed_service_models:ConsolidateRequest..rationale: Pydantic v2 field_validator classmethod invoked by the model's validation machinery during request parsing; decorating a validator can perturb pydantic's classmethod/validator resolution and adds a span per field-validate with no dashboard value. Pure input validation, not an observable op.

checkpoint_impl:_enrich_checkpoint_conte.rationale: Pure string helper: appends the action-buffer summary to custom_context (no I/O, no ops decision). Called from the already-@observe'd run_checkpoint_replay (write_exec.checkpoint_replay); a span here double-instruments the same replay with zero dashboard value.

wiki_add_impl:_mirror_wiki.rationale: Non-fatal thin delegation to FileQueue.write_wiki (itself @observe'd as queue.write_wiki) to mirror a page to a .md; wraps the call in a debug-log try/except. Called from the already-@observe'd run_wiki_add_replay; a span here recursively re-instruments the write_wiki op with no added diagnostic value.

orchestrator:_in_window.rationale: Pure time-arithmetic predicate: parses HH:MM start/end and returns whether now falls in the (possibly cross-midnight) window. No I/O, no ops decision. Called from the @observe'd maybe_auto_vacuum / core_post_cycle gate checks; a span per call is cardinality bloat on a string-in-window test.

cleanup:_observe_action_batch.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body is yadgar_action_batch_size.observe(n); wrapping a single histogram .observe() in @observe is recursive span noise for one metric touch, no diagnostic value.

cleanup:_observe_archive_purge.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: increments yadgar_archive_purged_total + retention_skipped counters for a completed purge; wrapping counter .inc() calls in @observe is recursive span noise with no ops value.

cleanup:_quarantine_action_group.rationale: Appends one poison-pill quarantine entry to a jsonl file; called per poison-pill action group inside the _process_action_log group loop (per-group on SecretLeakBlocked). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

cleanup:_bucket_for_timestamp.rationale: Computes a 30-minute bucket string for one timestamp; called per action-log row inside _group_rows_by_window (per-row, up to 200 rows per cycle). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

cleanup:_build_group_content.rationale: Builds a summary string for one action group; called per (directory,window) group inside the _process_action_log group loop (per-group). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.action_log carries the stage span.

cold_retention:_parse_tags.rationale: Parses one memory's tags field (JSON-string aware); called per candidate memory inside _is_candidate during the cold-retention scan (per-item, up to 10000 memories). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

cold_retention:_is_candidate.rationale: Evaluates the cold-retention candidate predicate for one memory; called per memory in the _cold_memory_retention_report scan comprehension (per-item, up to 10000). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent report carries the stage span.

cold_retention:_emit_cold_purge_candidat.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body is yadgar_cold_purge_candidates.set(count); wrapping a single gauge .set() in @observe is recursive span noise for one metric touch, no diagnostic value.

cls:_bump_cache_epoch_global.rationale: Cache-invalidation epoch bumper for Car 1/Car 2 caches: fully-guarded call to bump_epoch(None) that advances the global generation after a consolidation prior recompute, so project_brief / wiki caches see the structural change. Wrapping a single bump_epoch() in @observe is recursive span noise.

cls:_CLSMixin._build_entity_map.rationale: Merges typed+legacy entity extractions for one episode; called per episode inside the _process_new_episodes loop (per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.process_episodes carries the stage span.

cls:_CLSMixin._upsert_entities.rationale: Get-or-creates entities for one episode's entity map; called per episode inside the _process_new_episodes loop (per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.process_episodes carries the stage span.

cls:_CLSMixin._build_cooccurrence_batch.rationale: Builds the co-occurrence SQL write batch for one episode's entity set; called per episode inside the _process_new_episodes loop (per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent process_episodes carries the stage span.

cls:_CLSMixin._find_entity_by_type.rationale: Finds the first entity of a target type in one episode's entity map; called per typed-relationship inside _apply_one_typed_relationship (per-relationship, nested per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat.

cls:_CLSMixin._apply_one_typed_relations.rationale: Emits one typed graph edge for a single (name, ctx) pair; called per relationship context inside _apply_typed_relationships (per-relationship, nested per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

cls:_CLSMixin._apply_typed_relationships.rationale: Emits typed graph edges for one episode's relationship contexts; called per episode inside the _process_new_episodes loop (per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent process_episodes carries the stage span.

cls:_CLSMixin._extract_entities.rationale: Regex-extracts (name, type) pairs from one episode's raw content; called per episode inside the _process_new_episodes loop (per-episode). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent process_episodes carries the stage span.

cls:_CLSMixin._parse_unit_embedding.rationale: Parses one memory's embedding bytes to a unit-normalized ndarray; called per memory inside the _embedding_dedup valid-collection loop (per-item). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent embedding_dedup carries the stage span.

orchestrator:_warn_slow_phase.rationale: Threshold-log helper: emits a CRITICAL log only when one consolidation phase exceeds the warn threshold; called per phase inside _consolidation_cycle (many times per cycle). A span/metric per call is per-phase cardinality bloat; the enclosing phase-group stage span already covers timing.

clustering:_ClusteringMixin._mem_tags.rationale: Returns one memory's tags as a list (JSON-string aware); called per candidate memory inside the _build_unit_matrix filter loop (per-item, capped at CLS_PATTERN_MAX_CANDIDATES). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

clustering:_ClusteringMixin._try_unit_ve.rationale: Converts one memory's embedding bytes to a unit vector; called per candidate memory inside the _build_unit_matrix loop (per-item, capped at CLS_PATTERN_MAX_CANDIDATES). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent build_unit_matrix carries the stage span.

clustering:_ClusteringMixin._session_pro.rationale: Resolves a session identifier for one memory; called per cluster member inside the _qualify_cluster session-diversity loop (per-item). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

clustering:_ClusteringMixin._qualify_clu.rationale: Evaluates size + session-diversity thresholds for one cluster; called per detected cluster inside find_recurring_patterns' comprehension (per-cluster). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent find_patterns carries the stage span.

clustering:_ClusteringMixin._summarize_c.rationale: Builds a brief content summary for one cluster; called per qualifying cluster inside _qualify_cluster (per-cluster). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

patterns:_has_meaningful_token.rationale: Tests one text body for a meaningful (non-stopword) token; called per candidate content inside _is_degenerate_auto_abstracted and abstract_to_schema on the per-pattern promotion path (per-item). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

patterns:_is_degenerate_auto_abstracted.rationale: Detects a degenerate auto-abstracted schema for one content string; called per candidate pattern inside _promote_pattern (per-pattern in the CLS promotion loop). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.cls.promote carries the stage span.

patterns:_is_thin_auto_abstracted.rationale: Detects a thin (meta-token-dense) auto-abstracted schema for one content string; called per candidate pattern inside _schema_rejected_pre_promotion on the CLS promotion loop (per-pattern). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.cls.promote carries the stage span.

patterns:_distinct_real_tokens.rationale: Tokenizes one schema body and counts distinct real domain tokens; called once per candidate schema inside _is_thin_auto_abstracted on the per-pattern CLS promotion path. A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

promotion:_schema_rejected_pre_promotion.rationale: OR's the degenerate + thin write-time guards for one candidate schema; called per candidate pattern inside _promote_pattern (per-pattern in the CLS promotion loop). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent consolidation.cls.promote carries the stage span.

patterns:_collect_word_freq.rationale: Computes per-token document frequencies for one cluster's memories; called per promoted cluster inside abstract_to_schema (per-cluster). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat. Parent abstract_to_schema carries the hot span.

patterns:_build_ordered_common.rationale: Orders common words by first appearance for one cluster's schema; called per promoted cluster inside abstract_to_schema (per-cluster). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

patterns:_collect_common_tags.rationale: Collects tags above a frequency threshold for one cluster; called per promoted cluster inside abstract_to_schema (per-cluster). A span/metric per call is per-item cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

lru:LRUCache.get.rationale: O(1) LRU lookup called once per passage inside the _score_ce_with_cache / _encode_all per-text loops on the backend rerank+embed hot path (N calls per request). A span/metric per call is per-candidate cardinality bloat; the enclosing endpoint span covers it.

lru:LRUCache.put.rationale: O(1) LRU insert/evict called once per cache-miss passage inside the _score_ce_with_cache / _encode_all per-text loops on the backend hot path (per-miss per-request). A span/metric per call is per-candidate cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

lru:LRUCache.snapshot_age_seconds.rationale: A single os.stat mtime read returning seconds since last snapshot; called per cache (ce/embed) inside the periodic snapshot task and feeds the cache_snapshot_age_seconds gauge directly. Wrapping this stat helper in a span is noise; the parent snapshot stage span already covers timing.

cache:Cache.snapshot_age_seconds.rationale: Unified backend Cache twin of LRUCache.snapshot_age_seconds — a single os.stat mtime read returning seconds since last snapshot per namespace, feeding the snapshot-age gauge. Wrapping this one-stat helper in a span is noise; the parent snapshot stage span already covers timing.

cache:Cache._drop_locked.rationale: O(1) OrderedDict pop + byte-accounting decrement under the already-held instance lock; invoked per manual invalidate and per expired-TTL get on the backend hot path. A span/metric per call is per-key cardinality bloat with no dashboard value; the get/put/invalidate parent spans already cover it.

embed_service:lifespan.rationale: FastAPI ASGI lifespan async-generator (yields once between startup and shutdown); the framework enters/exits it and setup_tracing() inside it establishes the backend TracerProvider itself. @observe cannot wrap an async generator (it awaits the callable, not the generator), and a span spanning the entire process lifetime is meaningless.

embed_service:_run_cache_snapshot_task.rationale: Infinite `while True` background task that sleeps then snapshots CE+embed caches every interval; a stage decorator would open ONE span for the entire never-returning task lifetime rather than per-cycle. The per-op cache.save_snapshot stage spans are the correct per-cycle instrumentation.

embed_service:_require_admin_token.rationale: FastAPI dependency (Depends target) that verifies the admin bearer token; decorating it perturbs the Depends() signature resolution FastAPI relies on, and test_admin_auth_still_enforced_after_wrap proves auth must survive wrapping. The enclosing route boundary span already covers the request.

embed_service_models:EmbedRequest.valida.rationale: Pydantic v2 field_validator classmethod invoked by the model's validation machinery during request parsing; decorating a validator can perturb pydantic's classmethod/validator resolution and adds a span per field-validate with no dashboard value. Pure input validation, not an observable op.

embed_service_models:RerankRequest.valid.rationale: Pydantic v2 field_validator classmethod invoked by the model's validation machinery during request parsing; decorating a validator can perturb pydantic's classmethod/validator resolution and adds a span per field-validate with no dashboard value. Pure input validation, not an observable op.

embed_service:rerank.rationale: The /rerank route already emits its own RED family (yadgar_embed_rerank_requests_total / _duration_seconds / _503_total) AND opens a manual backend.rerank.{mode} inference span via start_as_current_span; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would double-span AND double the RED family. Verified by test_rerank_not_double_instrumented.

embed_service:rerank._score.rationale: Nested closure inside rerank() that dispatches to the ml client by mode (ce/nli/pair) and runs under the manual backend.rerank.{mode} span via asyncio.to_thread; not independently reachable and umbrella-covered by that inference span. Instrumenting it would emit a redundant child span for the wrapped dispatch.

embed_service:rerank._make_inference_spa.rationale: OTEL span factory nested in rerank(): returns an un-entered start_as_current_span('backend.rerank.{mode}') context manager (or nullcontext) entered by the rerank body. It OPENS the manual span rather than being wrapped by one; decorating would emit a redundant second span around the factory call.

embed_service:rerank._annotate_span.rationale: OTEL span-attribute setter nested in rerank(): sets rerank.mode/n_passages/model.name on the active backend.rerank.{mode} span. It mutates the current manual span rather than opening one, so wrapping it in @observe would emit a redundant child span for attribute writes.

_telemetry:_rpc_span.rationale: OTEL span factory: returns an un-entered start_as_current_span(name) context manager (or nullcontext) entered by RemoteMLClient.score_* callers to wrap their RPC. It OPENS the span rather than being wrapped by one; decorating would emit a redundant second span around the factory call.

_telemetry:_record_model_load.rationale: Telemetry emitter: observes the model_load_duration_seconds histogram AND opens a manual 'model.load' start_as_current_span with cold-load attributes. It emits a metric + opens its own body-span; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating would double-span the cold-load event and wrap a metric write.

_telemetry:_emit_unload_telemetry.rationale: Telemetry emitter: sets model_loaded gauges + increments model_unload_total AND opens a manual 'model.unload' start_as_current_span with idle attributes. It emits metrics + opens its own body-span; decorating it would double-span the unload event and wrap counter/gauge writes.

circuit_breaker:_CircuitBreaker._set_gau.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body sets yadgar_circuit_breaker_state.labels(endpoint).set(value); wrapping a single gauge .set() in @observe is recursive span noise for one metric touch with no diagnostic value. Called on every breaker state transition.

circuit_breaker:_CircuitBreaker._set_rea.rationale: Metric-emitting primitive: sole body sets yadgar_backend_reachable.labels(endpoint).set(value); wrapping a single gauge .set() in @observe is recursive span noise for one metric touch with no diagnostic value. Called on every breaker state transition.

remote_ml_client:RemoteMLClient.score_cr.rationale: Opens a manual rpc.rerank.ce span via _rpc_span() around the _rerank_rpc HTTP call; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would emit TWO spans for one RPC. Verified by test_remote_ml_client_score_methods_stay_exempt (must carry no sentinel).

remote_ml_client:RemoteMLClient.score_nl.rationale: Opens a manual rpc.rerank.nli span via _rpc_span() around the _rerank_rpc HTTP call; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would emit TWO spans for one RPC. Verified by test_remote_ml_client_score_methods_stay_exempt (must carry no sentinel).

remote_ml_client:RemoteMLClient.score_pa.rationale: Opens a manual rpc.rerank.pair span via _rpc_span() around the _rerank_rpc HTTP call; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would emit TWO spans for one RPC. Verified by test_remote_ml_client_score_methods_stay_exempt (must carry no sentinel).

recall_pipeline:_fuse_with_span.rationale: Opens a manual 'recall.fanout.fuse' span via `with span(...)` and sets dynamic memory/wiki candidate-count attributes around the cross-type CE fusion pass; @observe's guard only detects decorator spans, so decorating this body-span opener would emit TWO spans for one fusion and @observe's static attributes cannot replicate the per-call counts.

audit:_anchor_rank.rationale: Computes a keep-priority rank for one anchor row (word/header/tag scoring); called per redundant pair (twice per iteration: row_a and row_b) inside the _build_merge_actions _fetch_redundant_pairs loop. A span/metric per call is per-pair cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

audit:_cross_project_content_length_rati.rationale: Pure length-ratio of two content strings; called per candidate cross-project pair inside the _group_cross_project_pairs adjacency-building loop (per-pair, O(N^2) worst case). A span/metric per call is per-pair cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

audit:_cross_project_primary_rank.rationale: Computes the primary-selection rank for one cross-project row; invoked inside the _sort_key sorted() comparator (per element per comparison) when ordering cluster ids. A span/metric per call is per-comparison cardinality bloat with no dashboard value.

audit:_group_cross_project_pairs._sort_k.rationale: Nested sorted() key comparator that ranks one cluster member id; called per element per sort inside _group_cross_project_pairs (true inner-loop comparator). A span/metric per call is per-element cardinality bloat and it is umbrella-covered by the parent's stage span.

client:_inline_int_record_ids._sub.rationale: re.sub callback invoked once per type::record(…) token match inside _inline_int_record_ids; not independently reachable and covered by the parent function's hot span. Decorating a per-match regex callback adds per-token cardinality with zero dashboard value.

client:_validate_param_keys.rationale: Pure SurrealQL bind-param-name validator (regex match per key, raise ValueError on a bad name); no I/O and no ops decision. Called from the already-@observe'd _q_server/query execution paths, so a per-call span/metric double-instruments the hot query path with zero dashboard value (mirrors the cache:Cache._is_expired trivial-predicate exemption).

tracing:_install_span_log_queue.rationale: Observability framework primitive: sets up the background span-log queue thread. observe.py imports yadgar.tracing; adding @observe to tracing.py would create a circular import. These functions are the span infrastructure itself — wrapping them in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation noise.

tracing:_stop_span_log_queue.rationale: Observability framework primitive: stops the span-log queue thread. Circular import with observe.py (observe imports tracing). Self-instrumentation of the span shutdown path has no ops value.

tracing:_parse_otlp_headers.rationale: Observability framework primitive: parses OTLP exporter headers. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting the OTLP header parser via a span is recursive noise.

tracing:_build_otlp_exporter.rationale: Observability framework primitive: builds the OTLP span exporter. Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping span-exporter construction in @observe creates recursive self-instrumentation.

tracing:_CircuitBreakerSpanExporter.expo.rationale: Observability framework primitive: circuit-breaker wrapper around OTLP span export. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting the span exporter itself is recursive noise — it emits spans.

tracing:LogSpanProcessor._emit_span_log.rationale: Observability framework primitive: emits a span as a JSON log line. Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping a span-emitter in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation.

tracing:LogSpanProcessor._emit_span_log_.rationale: Observability framework primitive: the guarded body of _emit_span_log that emits the span_end JSON log line. Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping a span-emitter in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation (and would reopen the log-path recursion the re-entry guard closes).

tracing:_instrument_httpx.rationale: Observability framework primitive: instruments httpx with OpenTelemetry. Circular import with observe.py. Auto-instrumentation setup is not independently observable.

tracing:setup_tracing.rationale: Observability framework primitive: initialises the full OpenTelemetry tracing pipeline. Circular import with observe.py. Tracing bootstrap cannot be instrumented by the tracing system it initialises.

tracing:shutdown_tracing.rationale: Observability framework primitive: shuts down the tracing pipeline. Circular import with observe.py. Span-emitting instrumentation on the shutdown path risks lost spans and is recursive noise.

tracing:shutdown_tracing._run.rationale: Nested closure inside shutdown_tracing that runs the async shutdown in a background thread. Circular import with observe.py and is an inner-thread-runner, not independently reachable.

tracing:get_current_trace_id.rationale: Observability framework primitive: reads the current OTel trace ID from context. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a trace-context reader with a span is recursive noise.

tracing:get_current_span_id.rationale: Observability framework primitive: reads the current OTel span ID from context. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a span-context reader with a span is recursive noise.

tracing:trace_span.rationale: Observability framework primitive: the core @trace_span decorator factory. Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping a span-decorator in @observe is direct recursive self-instrumentation.

tracing:trace_span.decorator.rationale: Inner closure of trace_span: the returned decorator. Circular import with observe.py. Framework-internal closure of the span-decorator — recursive noise.

tracing:trace_span.decorator.async_wrapp.rationale: Async wrapper closure inside trace_span.decorator. Circular import with observe.py. Framework-internal span-emission wrapper — instrumenting it is recursive self-instrumentation.

tracing:trace_span.decorator.sync_wrappe.rationale: Sync wrapper closure inside trace_span.decorator. Circular import with observe.py. Framework-internal span-emission wrapper — instrumenting it is recursive self-instrumentation.

tracing:span.rationale: Observability framework primitive: context manager for opening a manual span. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a span-opener with @observe is direct recursive self-instrumentation.

metrics:_collect_process_metrics.rationale: Observability framework primitive: collects and sets process-level Prometheus gauges (CPU, RSS, FDs). observe.py imports yadgar.metrics; adding @observe here creates a circular import. These functions write metrics — wrapping them in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation noise.

metrics:loop_heartbeat.rationale: Observability framework primitive: increments the event-loop heartbeat counter on each loop iteration. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a per-loop-tick metric write is recursive noise with extreme per-call cardinality.

metrics:hook_record_failure.rationale: Observability framework primitive: records a hook execution failure counter. Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping a failure-counter writer in @observe adds recursive metric noise.

metrics:loop_record_exception.rationale: Observability framework primitive: records an event-loop exception counter + histogram. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting the exception-metric writer with @observe is recursive noise.

metrics:_record_loop_lag.rationale: Observability framework primitive: records the event-loop lag histogram. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a lag-histogram writer with @observe is recursive self-instrumentation.

metrics:_loop_lag_probe.rationale: Observability framework primitive: async probe that measures actual loop lag and records it. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting the lag probe itself would corrupt lag measurements.

metrics:stop_loop_lag_monitor.rationale: Observability framework primitive: stops the loop-lag background monitor task. Circular import with observe.py. Infrastructure teardown of a metrics monitor has no independent ops value.

metrics:_collect_pool_stats.rationale: Observability framework primitive: collects tool-pool gauges (idle/active/waiting workers). Circular import with observe.py. Wrapping a gauge-writer in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation.

metrics:_collect_queue_depths.rationale: Observability framework primitive: collects queue-depth gauges for all action queues. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting a queue-depth reporter is recursive noise.

metrics:_dq_count.rationale: Observability framework primitive: queries a data-quality metric count from the DB. Circular import with observe.py. Low-level DB read helper for a metrics collector — recursive noise if wrapped.

metrics:_parse_surprise_scores.rationale: Observability framework primitive: parses surprise-score rows from a DB result. Circular import with observe.py. Data-quality metrics helper — wrapping it in @observe adds noise with no dashboard value.

metrics:_dq_set_surprise_gauges.rationale: Observability framework primitive: sets surprise-score Prometheus gauges. Circular import with observe.py. Gauge-writer — wrapping in @observe is recursive self-instrumentation.

metrics:_collect_data_quality.rationale: Observability framework primitive: drives the full data-quality metrics collection cycle. Circular import with observe.py. Metrics-collection orchestrator — wrapping it in @observe is recursive noise.

metrics:metrics_handler.rationale: Observability framework primitive: HTTP handler that renders the /metrics Prometheus scrape endpoint. Circular import with observe.py. Instrumenting the metrics endpoint with a span/counter creates recursive self-instrumentation: every scrape would emit a span.

logs:LogRingHandler.emit.rationale: log-emission sink (pushes every LogRecord into the in-memory ring for the SSE /logs stream): an @observe here opens a span per record whose span_end log (via LogSpanProcessor) re-enters emit() → per-log span amplification flood (v5.106). Un-instrumentable by construction like log_config.py; the surrounding logs.py HTTP route handlers stay observed, so this is a per-fn key, not a file glob.

logs:_SpanEndFilter.filter.rationale: logging.Filter on LogRingHandler that drops OTel span_end telemetry from the app-log ring (v5.106 gap #3, ADR-0041). Runs on the log-emission path for EVERY record the ring handler processes: an @observe here opens a span per record whose span_end log (via LogSpanProcessor) re-enters the filter → per-log span amplification, the exact flood this filter exists to stop. Un-instrumentable by construction like LogRingHandler.emit / ContentRedactor.filter; per-fn key since surrounding logs.py route handlers stay observed.

log_config:RequestLoggingMiddleware.__ca.rationale: Nested ASGI send-capture closure inside RequestLoggingMiddleware.__call__. Not independently reachable; framework-internal response-capture that patches the ASGI send callable. Covered by the parent __call__ span.

embed_service_models:RecallRequest.valid.rationale: Pydantic @field_validator: pure input validation called by Pydantic model instantiation before any I/O. Decorating a validator with @observe adds a span to every model construction, which is per-request cardinality bloat on a trivial string-in-set check with no dashboard value.

embed_service_routes:recall_route._run_p.rationale: Inner thread-pool closure dispatched via asyncio.to_thread() inside the @observe-decorated recall_route() handler. The outer handler already carries the tri-signal span; adding a second span for the closure body produces a double-span with no boundary value — the trace already attributes the thread duration under the parent recall_route span.

_scan:_on_walk_error.rationale: One-line os.walk onerror callback: logs a permission-denied warning and returns. No ops decision, no I/O beyond the warning log, not a runtime or observable path — a span/metric yields zero dashboard value (folder-split #17: exposed when seed moved to core/seed).

_surreal_runner:_kill_all_spawned_surrea.rationale: Atexit-registered exception guard: wraps kill_all_spawned_surreal() in try/except so a shutdown-time logging error cannot force a non-zero process exit. No ops logic of its own, test-teardown infra only — a span/metric yields zero dashboard value (folder-split #17).

store:_wiki_observe_stage.rationale: Per-stage metric-emission helper called once per wiki-query stage (fts/embed_query/hnsw) inside the query hot path; it IS a metric writer (yadgar_wiki_query_stage_ms), so wrapping it with @observe would be circular and double-emit per stage.

cls:_batch_entity_degree.rationale: Module-level pure-compute helper: one list comprehension + one dict comprehension over already-fetched data. Called only from the @observe-d _compute_graph_priors; wrapping this 3-line helper adds redundant span nesting with zero dashboard signal (no I/O, no branching, no async).
